source_headlines_en: Opening the Door to New Possibilities in Hotel Security & Guest Satisfaction
short_english_fragments_en: Vingcard Novel
Keeping pace with new hotel security needs has never been more essential to the running of a successful business.

Today’s hoteliers require advanced solutions capable of not just perfectly balancing current guest demands for enhanced safety and convenience, but that can also continue to meet such needs far into the future as expectations inevitably evolve.
Opening the Door to New Possibilities in Hotel Security & Guest Satisfaction
Vingcard Novel represents hospitality’s ultimate combination of scalable security technology, all encased within a sleek door handle offering timeless design appeal

With Vingcard Novel, hoteliers gain a vital competitive advantage that can see their property effortlessly update security capabilities and add new features or integrations-all without costly hardware replacement and the hassle of time-consuming installation.
ideal lock solution for both indoor and outdoor areas
means to meet sustainability goals thanks to the use of materials and manufacturing processes that minimize its environmental impact.
Sustainability
Meeting the industry’s commitment to sustainable practices and lives up to guest expectations for environmentally friendly hotel operations.
Installation
Upgrading hotel security made simple: Bypassing installation and retrofit complex-ities using a revolutionary design proven to minimize down-time and ensure a visually appealing end result.

source_headlines_en: As Lightweight as it is Secure
short_english_fragments_en: Environmentally Conscious by Design
Manufactured using sustainable practices and consisting of recyclable components, Vingcard Novel is the door solution of choice for eco-conscious hoteliers.
As Lightweight as it is Secure
While capable of withstanding multiple physical break-in attempts, Vingcard Novel’s aluminum design weighs 35 percent less than older lock models.
Less weight means less to ship and reduced freight costs.
Vingcard Novel’s 61 percent reduction in packing volume and a 30 percent decrease in packing weight when compared to other lock options.
Easier Installation & Reduced Maintenance
Vingcard Novel’s minimalistic handle design doesn’t just translate into a sleeker appearance, it also represents effortless installation and reduced maintenance needs.

Vingcard Novel drastically cuts down on the number of components and moving parts-resulting in a straightforward and stress-free installation process that takes less time and minimizes the need for drilling.
Reduced components and moving parts also means that Vingcard Novel is able to withstand wear and tear that often leads to significant downtime as well as hardware replacement and labor costs.
quality_flags: Visual reading order is the main heading/introduction, then the left lightweight/comparison column, then the right installation/maintenance panel; the native text sequence differs.

The three infographic values were checked visually: 61% is reduction in packing volume; 35% is reduction in weight; 30% is reduction in packing weight. The native value tokens and native label blocks are noncontiguous, so no new paired quote was manufactured. The exact prose comparisons were selected instead.

The 35 percent weight claim is compared with older lock models. The 61 percent packing-volume and 30 percent packing-weight claims are compared with other lock options. Neither baseline identifies a model, sample, date or measurement method on this page.

The comparison percentages concern physical product and packaging characteristics, not energy savings, operating-cost savings or a general sustainability score. The physical break-in assertion is not treated as a test certification.
Source grammar and hard hyphens are retained, including parts-resulting and the singular means in Reduced components and moving parts also means.
omitted_native_content_notes: Footer, loose infographic number/label tokens and the component-photo caption omitted from excerpts. Hardware components visible in the photograph are not inventoried. Repetitive introductory sustainability prose not excerpted in full.

source_headlines_en: Bringing an End to Battery Waste & Replacement
short_english_fragments_en: Bringing an End to Battery Waste & Replacement
Door lock batteries are a recurring source of waste and a loss of employee time whenever one needs to be checked and replaced.
With Vingcard Novel, hoteliers now have the option to do away with batteries altogether using an innovative and patent pending alternative to powering each lock.

Capable of wirelessly transferring power from the side door frame to the lock, Vingcard Novel translates into less environmental waste from dead batteries, less overhead expenses and more time for hotel staff to focus on other responsibilities.
Minimizing Eco-footprints with Recyclable Materials
With its 100 percent recyclable lock trim that offers superior finish quality, Vingcard Novel extends its minimal environmental impact all the way to the end-of-life product cycle.
Sustainable packaging
Each lock is delivered using a fully recycled paper box.
By significantly reducing the use of harmful plastic packaging materials, Vingcard Novel also works towards ensuring a planet free of micro-plastic waste for us all.
quality_flags: The left battery/power column, right recyclable-materials column and bottom packaging panel were read in visual order.

Battery elimination is an optional alternative and the source calls it patent pending. Wireless transfer is specifically from the side door frame to the lock; it is not generic wireless networking or mobile-device charging.
The 100 percent recyclable claim applies specifically to the lock trim, not to the complete lock, all electronics or all packaging.

Fully recycled paper box is the source wording. Reduction in harmful plastic packaging and the planet free of micro-plastic waste sentence are presented as source aspiration; the text does not say that the complete delivered package contains zero plastic.
omitted_native_content_notes: Footer and the aluminum element-tile tokens Al, 13 and 26.982 omitted as material/technical decoration. Repeated general security, convenience and environmental marketing prose not selected in full.

short_english_fragments_en: Sleek Design Embodying Ultimate Elegance
Vingcard Novel is as much about enhancing property style as it is about empowering hoteliers with the latest in security technology.

Available as a sleek minimalistic lock for new installations as well as a slightly larger version for retrofit project needs, Vingcard Novel nonetheless offers the ability to seamlessly blend in with any hotel décor.
Custom-tailored Finishes able to Suit any Interior Design Need
In addition to the lock’s range of standard finishes, customers can also make requests for custom-tailored finishes depending on their specific needs and order quantity.
With Vingcard Novel, the possibilities for creating a captivating exterior design are virtually limitless.

source_headlines_en: Setting a New Standard in Operational Efficiency
Protecting Your Door Lock Investment From Avoidable Damage
short_english_fragments_en: Setting a New Standard in Operational Efficiency
Vingcard Novel is a door lock solution offering simplified operation far into the long-term future.
Battery-free solution
While available as a battery-free solution, properties that install the locks using batteries can further look forward to two years of operation before replacement is required based on normal usage.
Protecting Your Door Lock Investment From Avoidable Damage
Hotel door locks are often unintentionally subjected to damage by housekeeping teams who routinely throw the bolt when the door is open while cleaning a room.
By allowing the deadbolt to be thrown only when the door is in the frame, Vingcard Novel prevents any damage from being inflicted on either the door frame or lock itself.

کارت‌ها/آیکون‌ها جدا بمانند. عنوان اصلی ص۵ دیرتر از فهرست در native آمده؛ bbox/رندر ترتیب عنوان را تعیین می‌کند. optional cylinder، alternative power و Vostio/Apple Wallet در مورد خود حفظ شوند. ANS BHMA ص۴ با ANSI ص۱۴/۱۵ بی‌صدا اصلاح نشود.
ترتیب دیداری پایین ستون چپ: ۶۱٪ حجم بسته‌بندی، ۳۵٪ وزن محصول، ۳۰٪ وزن بسته‌بندی. native اعداد را اول و captionها را آخر می‌آورد. عنوان/مقدمه، ستون چپ مقایسهٔ وزن و ستون راست نصب/نگهداری مستقل بمانند.
ستون چپ گزینهٔ تغذیه، ستون راست recyclable lock trim و نوار پایین recycled paper box جدا هستند. Al/13/26.982 نقش جدول تناوبی با متن native است؛ شمارهٔ صفحه، معیار بازیافت یا فیچر نرم‌افزار نیست.
مقدمه پیش از گالری و کارت زرد سفارشی‌سازی بعد از آن است. captionهای پنج پرداخت از عکس خود در native جدا افتاده‌اند؛ اتصال بصری حفظ شود. شرط نیاز و تعداد سفارش برای درخواست سفارشی‌سازی حذف نشود.
Your style. Spot on. متن native اصلی است؛ صفحه image-only یا blank نیست. پانوشت تکراری به شعار اضافه یا دوباره‌شماری نشود.
شبکهٔ ۲×۲: بالاچپ۱، بالاراست۲، پایین‌چپ۳، پایین‌راست۴. شماره‌ها و Installation steps native‌اند؛ برای هر عکس دستور نصب فنی ساختگی نوشته نشود. شرح One Lockcase در ستون چپ جداست.

عنوان Mobile Access / Adoption Made Simple بالای عکس ولی آخر native است. تیتر No need ... و بدنهٔ پایین همراه شرط software license agreement خوانده شوند. نوشتهٔ عکس گوشی native نیست و آمار/رکورد جدا می‌خواهد.

ترتیب دیداری: عنوان/مقدمه، 1 million lock cycles، Battery-free solution، Protecting ... From Avoidable Damage. native بند محافظت را زودتر می‌آورد. دو سال برای نصب باتری‌دار و normal usage است؛ عنوان battery-free نباید دامنهٔ آن را تغییر دهد.
70°C/158°F روی عکس بالا و -20°C/-4°F روی عکس پایین است؛ بدنهٔ میانی تکرار همان محدوده است. علامت منفی و هر دو واحد حفظ شوند؛ اعداد evidence سخت‌افزار خارج feature bank هستند.

عنوان/گواهی‌ها بالا، دستکاری و عکس Mortise در میانه، کارت Vostio/cloud پایین است؛ native بند Vostio را اول می‌آورد. EN 1303 متعلق به سیلندر اختیاری و regular updates متعلق به Vostio است. عبارت Vingcard’s Novel’s بی‌صدا اصلاح نشود.

عنوان، دو ستون آیکون، تصویر برش محصول و نوار گواهی به ترتیب دیداری جدا شوند. requires Online option فقط به آلارم بالاراست تعلق دارد. عدد native 1 در badge قرمز، پاورقی/مرحله/تأخیر یا تعداد قابلیت نیست. پاراگراف گواهی پایین از فهرست بالا مستقل است.
04/2025 نسخهٔ سند است؛ copyright سال مستقل ندارد. هشدار تغییر مشخصات و تفاوت رنگ تصویر با محصول حفظ شود؛ وضعیت فعلی محصول از نسخه نتیجه نمی‌شود.
